facts.assertion: The witness heard the collision from inside number 41.
facts.subject: witness_observation
facts.quoted_text: I was in my front room at number 41 when I heard the bang

facts.assertion: A dark blue hatchback was across the middle of the road with front-end damage.
facts.subject: post_impact_position
facts.quoted_text: a dark blue hatchback across the middle of the road with its front end damaged

facts.assertion: The road was wet and it had been raining on and off all day.
facts.subject: road_conditions
facts.quoted_text: The road was wet; it had been raining on and off all day

facts.assertion: The witness did not see the collision itself, only the aftermath.
facts.subject: witness_observation_limit
facts.quoted_text: I did not see the collision itself, only what was there afterwards
